rows.title: Nothing linked says why
rows.defect: the reasons are checked in the wrong order, so an unlinked provider is said to have no adapter
rows.test: each connector says 'not linked by the user'

rows.title: Linked is not wired
rows.defect: linking a provider is taken as a working rail
rows.test: linked Schwab with no adapter is NOT_WIRED

rows.title: Live and linked
rows.defect: a live adapter wires without the person's link
rows.test: a live adapter the person never linked is NOT_WIRED

rows.title: A sandbox is not a rail
rows.defect: any adapter other than none wires (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a sandbox adapter is NOT_WIRED

rows.title: Live means live
rows.defect: the word live anywhere in the adapter state counts (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: 'not live: awaiting the partner' is not LIVE

rows.title: A report is not evidence
rows.defect: cancelled is missing from the report words
rows.test: 'cancelled' is said to be a report

rows.title: Every needed field
rows.defect: only the first needed field is checked
rows.test: an order id with no status lacks status

rows.title: Numbers tie to the rows
rows.defect: a dollar of rounding is let through

rows.title: No next charge
rows.defect: the scheduled next charge is not checked
rows.test: cancelled with a next charge scheduled is not done

rows.title: The finished state is the item's
rows.defect: the read-back's own expected_state is trusted
rows.test: a read-back that expects active and reads active is not a cancellation

rows.title: A fill of something
rows.defect: any number is a quantity, zero included (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a fill of 0 shares is not done

rows.title: Compared to what was asked
rows.defect: an open order with no requested parameters passes (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: an open order with nothing to compare is unknown

rows.title: Staged is not delivered
rows.defect: only drafted counts as not delivered
rows.test: a staged Venmo send is not done

rows.title: Something moved
rows.defect: a zero or negative amount passes when the balances agree with it (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a $0 or reversed transfer is not done

rows.title: A credit above zero
rows.defect: a $0 credit row counts as posted (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a $0 credit against $0 expected is not done

rows.title: A payout above zero
rows.defect: a $0 payout row counts as landed (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a $0 payout is not done

rows.title: Never the PIN
rows.defect: the PIN in the evidence is not checked
rows.test: a PIN in the evidence fails the freeze

rows.title: Never invents a name
rows.defect: an unfilled placeholder is left in the text as <brokerage>
rows.test: no brokerage known says 'that brokerage'

rows.title: In flight is not done
rows.defect: a pending result is said done
rows.test: a queued order is said in flight

rows.title: Only a live run
rows.defect: the provider mode is not checked, so a sandbox run counts
rows.test: a sandbox fill is not done

rows.title: Fifteen sub-capabilities
rows.defect: any packet size proves
rows.test: a 14 sub-capability packet does not prove the item

rows.title: Sandbox is not LIVE
rows.defect: a sandbox counterparty is reported LIVE
rows.test: C73's local merchant is SANDBOX
